nasa_apod.title: Turtle Rock on Mars
nasa_apod.explanation: Is this a fossilized turtle on Mars?  No.  Although resembling a large Earth tortoise, this is a layered rock outcrop on Mars that is estimated to span about 15 meters, making it much larger than turtles on Earth. NASA’s robotic Curiosity rover came across this unusual mound, dubbed Miraflores, last...
